children.name: first_name
children.description: The first name of the user.

children.name: last_name
children.description: The last name of the user.

children.name: avatar_url
children.description: The avatar URL of the user.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: roles
children.description: The RBAC roles to assign to the user, each optionally scoped.

children.name: role_id
children.description: The ID of the role to assign.

children.name: scopes
children.description:
The scopes the role is constrained to, e.g.
`[{ type: "organization", id: "org_123" }]`.

types.name: rbac_context
types.description:
The actor creating the users. When provided, it can only create users
with roles whose policies it holds itself.
